# Tayyab Manan - AI/ML Engineer

> Portfolio of Tayyab Manan, an AI/ML Engineer specializing in Computer Vision, NLP/LLMs, Geospatial AI, and production ML systems. Featured work includes an Urdu LLM fine-tuned with QLoRA, an explainable US-visa outcome predictor, ML-powered groundwater prediction from satellite data, and multi-agent workflows built with LangChain and AutoGen. Technical expertise spans Python, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-learn, Hugging Face, LangChain, FastAPI, Docker, and MLOps. Currently an AI Developer at Cointegration and a Master's student in AI Engineering at COMSATS. Open to full-time AI/ML roles.

## About

I'm an AI/ML Engineer building production machine learning systems across Computer Vision, NLP, and Geospatial AI. My work spans LLM fine-tuning, explainable prediction models, multi-agent workflows, and satellite-data forecasting. I combine ML engineering, evaluation rigor, and full-stack deployment to ship systems that solve real problems. I work as an AI Developer at Cointegration and am pursuing a Master's in AI Engineering at COMSATS. I'm open to full-time AI/ML roles.

## Featured Projects

- [Do Spikes Fail Differently?](https://tayyabmanan.com/projects/do-spikes-fail-differently): A matched reliability study of a spiking neural network and its ReLU twin on DVS128Gesture, an event-camera gesture dataset. Same architecture, parameter count, data, seed, and training; only the neuron differs. Measures accuracy, calibration, robustness under four corruptions, temporal sensitivity, and accounting-model energy with bootstrap 95% CIs. The spiking model gives up 3.5 accuracy points and gains a calibration tie, up to +28 points under sensor noise with confidence that tracks accuracy, and 18.7x lower energy on paper. Single seed, n=288. Live demo at https://tayyabmanan.com/demo/spikes. Stack: Python, PyTorch, SpikingJelly, Modal, FastAPI, Next.js.
- [Urdu LLM Fine-Tuning](https://tayyabmanan.com/projects/urdu-llm-fine-tuning): A Qwen 2.5 7B Instruct model fine-tuned with QLoRA to speak natural Urdu, Roman Urdu, and Urdu/English code-mixing. Reaches a 79.5% pairwise win rate over the base model across two independent LLM judges on a 100-prompt evaluation set, with RAG-aware training for factual queries. Validated with a blinded multi-judge harness and shipped as a live Gradio + Modal demo. Built end-to-end in public for about $60. Stack: Python, PyTorch, Unsloth, QLoRA/PEFT, Hugging Face, Modal.

- [US Visa Approval Prediction](https://tayyabmanan.com/projects/us-visa-prediction): Predicts US PERM labor-certification outcomes and explains each decision with SHAP. Built as a 5-stage MLOps pipeline with GridSearchCV across 5 boosting models, threshold tuning for denied-recall, and a FastAPI backend. 73.2% accuracy (vs 66.8% naive baseline) on 25K records. Stack: Python, Scikit-learn, XGBoost, SHAP, FastAPI.

- [WaterTrace Pakistan](https://tayyabmanan.com/projects/watertrace): ML-powered groundwater prediction system using 22 years of NASA satellite data (GRACE & GLDAS). Features time-series forecasting models achieving R²=0.89 accuracy, processing 235 monthly observations across 145 districts. Built with React, Flask, Scikit-learn, and Google Earth Engine. Addresses Pakistan's critical water crisis through predictive analytics.

- [TeacherRank](https://tayyabmanan.com/projects/teacher-rank): Full-stack student-driven teacher review platform with multi-dimensional rating system. Built with React 18, TypeScript, Supabase (PostgreSQL + real-time subscriptions), TanStack Query, and Tailwind CSS. Features include JWT authentication, row-level security, real-time synchronization, advanced search with caching, and PWA capabilities. Lighthouse score 95+.

- [EV Suitability Analysis](https://tayyabmanan.com/projects/ev-analysis): Geospatial AI system for optimal EV charging station placement using multi-criteria decision analysis (MCDA) and weighted scoring algorithms. Integrates 2023 Pakistan Census data, OpenStreetMap infrastructure, and demographic indicators. Built with Python, GeoPandas, and QGIS. Identified 5 priority sites through ML-optimized ranking for 90%+ coverage.

## Technical Blog Posts

- [Do Spikes Fail Differently? A Matched SNN vs ANN Reliability Study](https://tayyabmanan.com/blog/do-spikes-fail-differently-snn-vs-ann): The full write-up of the spiking-vs-ReLU study: the matched-pair design, why confidence must not be softmax for MSE-trained rate outputs, bootstrap intervals and paired tests at n=288, the noise crossover where the ReLU network fails confidently and the spiking network degrades honestly, the energy accounting with its bookkeeping correction, and the live demo. 14-minute read.
- [Building WaterTrace: ML-Powered Groundwater Prediction](https://tayyabmanan.com/blog/building-watertrace): Comprehensive technical deep-dive into building a geospatial AI system. Covers Google Earth Engine data processing, time-series feature engineering, Scikit-learn model development (Linear Regression, Random Forest, Gradient Boosting), SHAP model interpretation, handling data gaps between GRACE and GLDAS sources, deployment challenges (Render cold starts vs Cloudflare Workers), and frontend optimization with React and Recharts. 12-minute read covering the complete ML pipeline from satellite data to production deployment.

- [Building TeacherRank: Student-Driven Review Platform](https://tayyabmanan.com/blog/building-teacherrank): Full-stack web development case study covering React + TypeScript architecture, Supabase backend implementation, TanStack Query caching strategies, real-time data synchronization, database schema design with foreign keys and RLS policies, performance optimization (code splitting, virtual scrolling, image optimization achieving 60% bundle reduction), security implementation (JWT auth, input sanitization, rate limiting), and planned AI enhancements (sentiment analysis, recommendation engine, anomaly detection). 10-minute read with code examples and performance metrics.
